title: The technician field is blank only with no lead and no line technician
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  • Technicians: 2 eligible technicians at this location, named as the expected results name them: "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards". A technician is eligible when Time Clock is on, the staff member is active (not deactivated), the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Blank Technician" (used by this case only), with one contact and one asset.
  • Three Approved work orders for this customer: (a) [WO-a] no lead and no line technician; (b) [WO-b] no lead, one line given to Ralph Edwards; (c) [WO-c] lead Esther Howard and no line technician.
  • What must hold: exactly these three work orders for this customer.

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm each technician below exists and is eligible, or add them with New Staff Member: First Name and Last Name ("Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards") and an email; a Role that is not Office User or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"); at least one Department (required); Location = this location; Time Clock on > Save & Close.
  2. Top menu Customers > New Customer, Name "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Blank Technician" > Save (skip if it already exists). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Record the customer as [Cust-1].
  3. Create three work orders, each with one line: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in New Work Order pick Customer [Cust-1] and its Asset > Save. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open: in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line, turn Line Approved on (this makes the work order Approved) > Save & Add Line for the next line or Save & Close. Record the numbers shown as [WO-a], [WO-b], [WO-c]. Pick any ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot").
  4. On [WO-b] give the line to Ralph Edwards (Edit Line > Technicians); leave its Lead Technician Unassigned.
  5. On [WO-c] pick Lead Technician "Esther Howard" (the dropdown appears once the work order is Approved); leave its line with no technician.
  6. Leave [WO-a] with no lead and no line technician.
  7. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Blank Technician" in Search — exactly [WO-a], [WO-b] and [WO-c] show, all Approved; only [WO-c] has a Lead Technician (Esther Howard). If it does not match, fix the work order (or create it again) before starting.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View").
  2. Type [Cust-1] ("ZZAUTOTEST F3 Blank Technician") in Search.
  3. Turn line technicians on in Fields to display and read the field on each of the three cards.
  4. Pick Tech View with Assigned Techs on (Column Selection > Assigned Techs) and read the column for the three rows.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • (a) is blank. (b) shows Ralph Edwards. (c) shows Esther Howard. So only 1 of the 3 is blank. A "-" in an empty cell counts as blank.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10050 (Story 7, Show line technicians on cards and rows); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S7-N1, read 8 Oct 2026. Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Claude Design project 787fef1a, Work Orders.dc.html): an empty group renders "-"; write down whether blank shows as empty or as a dash. Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-N1: “The field/column is blank only when there is no lead technician and no assigned line technician.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
